description: Continue a failed job (caption_video, transcribe, create_clips, dub, remove_silences, generate_metadata) from where it stopped instead of starting over. Reuses saved transcription chunks and finished steps, so you pay only what is left (often just the burn); the failed job stays refunded. Idempotent: repeating returns the same resumed job, never a second charge. Returns a new job id to poll with get_job. 422 resume_not_supported or resume_media_expired: call the original tool again. 409 job_not_resumable (no_speech): nothing to resume.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

maxCredits.description: Refuse if resuming would cost more than this.
